headline: Jio Platforms IPO Receives Record 10 Million-Plus Applications
summary: Jio Platforms' initial public offering surpassed 10 million applications, setting a global record with subsequent estimates reaching between 13.4 million and 13.9 million bids.
why: Jio Platforms is India's leading telecommunications and digital services provider, controlled by Reliance Industries.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries
impacts.why: Massive retail and institutional participation unlocks capital and confirms strong market valuation for its telecom unit.
